import csv,re,collections
P=re.compile('аерск|aersk',re.I)
rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('normalized/cash_moves.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if P.search(str(r.get('counterparty') or ''))]
pays=[r for r in rows if (r.get('expense_uo') or '').strip() not in ('','0')]
print('виплат:',len(pays))
print('expense заповнено:',sum(1 for r in pays if (r.get('expense') or '').strip()))
print('currency заповнено:',sum(1 for r in pays if (r.get('currency') or '').strip()))
print('валюти:',dict(collections.Counter((r.get('currency') or 'порожньо').strip() for r in pays)))
print('приклад рядка:',{k:(v[:28] if isinstance(v,str) else v) for k,v in list(pays[0].items())})
